title: Welcome
subtitle: A tiny deck builder with big feelings

image.alt: Riso-style retro projector beaming a confetti of pastel slides

headline: Why Slide-o-Matic?
body: Make a slideshow like you'd leave a voicemail — fast, warm, and done.
Everything saves to your browser. No accounts, no cloud, no fuss.
The link's ready whenever you are.

image.alt: Riso retro microphone singing slides into the air

headline: Three keys and you're dangerous
body: That's the whole learning curve. Press **?** anytime for the rest.

pillars.title: E — Edit
pillars.text: Opens the workbench. Change words, swap images, rearrange.

pillars.title: T — Theme
pillars.text: Shuffles the vibe. Keep pressing until it feels like you.

pillars.title: V — Voice
pillars.text: Talk, get a slide. The fastest way from brain to screen.

headline: “Bless the mess. Compress the chaos. Ship the thing.”
Pick your adventure
body: Want the full tour? [Open the field guide](deck.html#slides=guide) — five minutes, everything explained.
In a hurry? Head home and grab a template — The Pitch, The Talk, Show & Tell, or The Weird One.
Or just press **E** right now and start typing over this deck. It's yours.
